scope: Exactly 12 IDs in identity_data-next.json; current source, reachable check helpers, native field production and directed offline collector-to-engine evidence.

project.facts: Project.name is an output-only numeric projects/{number} resource name. projectId is the immutable user-assigned identifier.

sink.facts: LogSink.destination declares the export target; a sink record does not attest successful writes.

bucket_list.facts: Buckets.list enumerates a project; projection=full includes all properties, while pagination must be consumed before absence claims.

key.facts: Key.name uses a project number; createTime is RFC3339. ApiTarget service and methods are case insensitive. Client restrictions form a oneof. Empty API targets permit all targets.

key_list.facts: GET project/global keys list returns keys and nextPageToken; showDeleted is optional and is not set by this collector.

usage.facts: Service name identifies the consumer project and canonical service; state distinguishes ENABLED and DISABLED.

backend.facts: BackendBucket.bucketName references a Cloud Storage bucket; this is a declaration, not an ownership or existence result.

bucket.facts: Bucket names share a global namespace. retentionPolicy exposes retentionPeriod, effectiveTime and isLocked.

perimeter.facts: status is enforced; spec is a proposed dry-run configuration. Project resources use projects/{projectNumber}. Bridges do not define restricted services. Ingress/egress allowances still affect access.

access_policies.facts: List policies by organization parent, then list each access policy servicePerimeters; pagination matters.

metric.facts: LogMetric.name is a metric identifier, not a qualified name; collector prefixes its scope. filter selects events. disabled stops points; bucketName limits the owning Log Bucket. Descriptor defaults are DELTA/INT64.

alert.facts: On reads missing enabled is unknown. A populated validity identifies an invalid policy that cannot generate incidents. Conditions combine by combiner; threshold filter, comparison and thresholdValue determine the triggering series.

query.facts: Additional AND predicates narrow matching events; substring inclusion of a required predicate does not prove the intended event coverage.

sql.facts: cloudsql.instances.update is an Admin Activity method.

storage.facts: Storage audit records distinguish methods and resource types; metadata joins do not validate real event delivery.

backup.facts: Automated backup audit events use windowStatus; STATUS_FAILED is final window failure, unlike STATUS_ATTEMPT_FAILED.

kms.facts: DisableCryptoKeyVersion and DestroyCryptoKeyVersion have KMS audit method names; collecting policy declarations does not execute these operations.

test_run.network: Autouse fixture blocks socket.connect/connect_ex/create_connection plus DNS functions and real Credentials; fake transport independently verifies HTTPS, method, exact host/path and scope, and records unplanned requests even if collector catches the exception.
test_run.mutation: Only the two owned files and bounded cohort /tmp artifacts were created; no runtime, catalog, ledger or shared CSV edits, no cloud authentication, commits, push, deployment or suite-wide run.

upstream_parity.assessment: Fresh 766-ID parity is an accounting map, not semantic certification. This cohort found implementation counterexamples in active checks; it does not reclassify deliberate owner-policy exclusions as missing automation.

specific_differences.assessment: Cached current Prowler also compares service strings case-sensitively. The native false PASS is a real API-contract issue, not fixed by matching that upstream predicate.
Prowler passes client-only restrictions while native iam_api_key_restricts_apis requires API targets; intentional narrower native declaration contract, not exact equivalence.

Cached SQL joins storage bucket name to backend bucket name rather than bucketName. The new native witness deliberately uses backend name backend and bucketName review-assets, correctly PASSing when review-assets exists; unknown global absence remains MANUAL.

Cached SQL uses the same shallow metric filter regex and alert filter substring as the assigned native closure. Mapping to a related active native is not evidence that the impossible/invalid/narrowed native witnesses are safe.

Cached SQL also inherits regex/substr-only qualification. The new gcs_bucket witness narrows bucket_name and still PASSes; the API contract requires stronger supported coverage proof if PASS is to mean an alert for those changes.

Current cached Prowler can additionally PASS on an explicit vpcServiceControlsUniqueIdentifier denial. Assigned native check requires readable enforced perimeter status and conservatively leaves generic denial UNKNOWN; parity should not claim exact branch equivalence.
Fresh mapping points to its active survivor rather than this duplicate scoped declaration; this cohort does not invent a missing upstream implementation from the assigned ID lacking an exact map.

owner_policy_exclusions.assessment: The resolved shared SQL compares each non-project user/group/domain/service-account member against $1-$4 trusted-principal lists; only-project members produce INFO. IAM APIs expose bindings but do not establish organizational trust of every identity. Public principal detection is automatable separately; it does not replace the trust-list predicate.

checks.code_assessment: age uses createTime and the immutable collector observation time, parses timezone-qualified timestamps, and compares <= UTC midnight 90 days before capture. This is a calendar-date cutoff, not a rolling 90*24h interval; exactly the cutoff fails.
checks.producer_assessment: API Keys list field mask explicitly includes createTime. Collector writes _provenance.collected_at from read_time; engine does not replace it with evaluation wall time. showDeleted is unset, so native list excludes deleted keys by default.
proof_limits: Creation age does not establish last rotation or last use. Tests use dates relative to native collection time; no effective credential-use test is made.

checks.code_assessment: caller_restrictions enforces exactly one client mode, validates the mode body and selected list type, rejects empty allowlists and explicit unrestricted strings such as ::/0 and *, and emits UNKNOWN for malformed/null facts. Android currently validates a list of objects, rather than package/fingerprint semantics.
checks.producer_assessment: The API-key collector selects all restrictions. For exactly one readable present mode, an omitted repeated list becomes [] with explicit empty coverage; missing modes, malformed bodies and denied parent/field markers are not filled. The producer does not retrieve key material.
proof_limits: Declaration only. This cohort tests all four native client modes but does not certify URL-pattern equivalence, all IP spellings, or effective mobile app identity. Validity of Android application package/fingerprint fields is assumed from native API admission; malformed synthetic objects are not positive proof.

checks.code_assessment: retained_destination applies only to storage.googleapis.com sink destinations, then unique_join requires one exact bucket name in complete inventory. A present isLocked true passes; absent retentionPolicy or false/missing isLocked fails. Non-Storage sinks are NOT_APPLICABLE and external destination buckets remain UNKNOWN.
checks.producer_assessment: log_sink transform prefixes the local sink name while preserving destination. buckets.list projection=full retains retentionPolicy and producer provenance; the join uses the global bucket name. Partial or denied bucket inventory cannot prove a locked retention declaration.
proof_limits: Checks locked retention, not a minimum period, successful export, retained volume, log completeness or effective data access. A bucket in another project is outside the selected project enumeration and is not falsely classified absent/unlocked.

checks.code_assessment: The registered _load_53 evaluator dispatches through _backup_alert, _base/_indexed/_rows, then the native configured_alerts helper. The helper independently supports final-window LogMatch or integer DELTA-counter thresholds, rejects invalid policies and uncertain narrowing/AND/threshold contracts. The outer guard incorrectly requires native project.name == selected scope.
checks.producer_assessment: CRM v3 normally returns projects/{number} plus projectId even when requested with a project ID. Collector preserves that authoritative name. Metrics and policy masks supply the native helper fields, including descriptor kind/value type and validity; numeric-scope pipelines pass, while project-ID scopes are blocked before helper evaluation.
proof_limits: The helper covers final scheduled-backup window failure, not STATUS_ATTEMPT_FAILED, arbitrary filter equivalence, metrics-scope cross-project coverage or delivered notifications. Numeric-scope positive witnesses include complete native conditions and descriptors.

defect.observed: Normal project-ID scope + numeric CRM native name produces UNKNOWN for complete/direct/absent/invalid scenarios instead of PASS/PASS/FAIL/FAIL
defect.required_fix: Bind numeric CRM name and projectId to the exact selected scope using authoritative project metadata and request provenance, accepting proven aliases while rejecting foreign, duplicate, partial or denied project identity. Keep the native alert helper safeguards.

checks.code_assessment: The scope-target _load_54._alerts uses strict _scope/_inventory completeness and duplicate identity checks, parses a bounded OR of KMS Disable/Destroy method equalities, then accepts an enabled metric-linked threshold. It validates neither the alert policy project name nor validity, feasible threshold or multi-condition combiner.
checks.producer_assessment: alert_policy is a derived inventory from complete monitoring_alert_policy with source request receipts; the original policy native name, validity and conditions survive. The derivation marks full representation despite the parent field mask, but all fields used in these witnesses are present in that mask. Foreign-name and invalid-policy witnesses reach the consumer intact.
proof_limits: No actual key disable/destroy operations, event production, incident creation or channel delivery are tested. The bounded OR parser correctly refuses additional filter clauses; this is distinct from the unsafe policy acceptance cases.

defect.observed: invalid, impossible_threshold, and_combiner and foreign all return PASS
defect.required_fix: Validate policy identity against the selected project with proven aliases, reject invalid policies, and require supported feasible counter thresholds and an independently satisfied combiner. Preserve duplicate/completeness guards.
